scope: Native Codex implicit discovery plus requirements-transition and profile-lifecycle checks, not a design-quality benchmark.

environment.early_stop_policy: Three implementation requests stopped after a successful skill read; no completed UI or visual quality claim.
environment.timeout_policy: 210 seconds initially; one field-definition timeout retried once with 300 seconds.
environment.final_body_note: After the behavior runs, saving-offer wording was narrowed to representative-result acceptance or explicit reuse intent. The tested description is unchanged.

observations: Requests did not name skills or tell the model to read instructions. Normal installed skill catalog was available; no new global routing rule was added.
Requirements and PPT advice used the actual fixture audience/format/brand, and did not produce files.
Two text-only custom-brand runs loaded the skill but omitted the optional save reminder. Activation and lifecycle behavior are graded separately.
One form-fields negative timed out initially and completed on retry; the timeout was not counted as a pass.
Independent review verified profile v2 -> v3, retained brand rules, and changes limited to the selected profile.

Accepted-preview case explicitly recommended saving a reusable company style, without writing any files. Text-only design advice did not prompt saving; final wording limits the offer to reviewed results or clear reuse intent.
limits: One main run per request with targeted reruns; these sample results do not guarantee future activation.
Only Codex CLI 0.163.0 with configured gpt-6-astra/ultra was exercised; desktop and other hosts were not benchmarked.
Three implementation requests stopped after activation, so visual quality and completed artifact rendering are not evaluated.
Earlier baseline samples used a different planning fixture and some used memory; they are exploratory evidence, not a controlled causal estimate of description improvement.
Local skill-use disclosure may still be required by host instructions, even though no manual skill activation or design questionnaire is needed.

runs.prompt: 给仓库管理员做一个本地库存查询页面，能按品名筛选，库存不足的要看得出来。用当前目录的数据，先做一个能点能筛选的页面。
给这个现有项目增加一个设置页，放通知开关和每页显示条数，和现在的页面保持一致。只在当前目录改。
返修登记的需求就按 README 里的范围确定：登记、查询、处理进度，三种角色也都确认了。还没开始做界面，现在下一步怎么安排？先说建议，不用创建文件。
这份给经销商看的新品发布 PPT，内容已经确认：产品定位、三个卖点、两组对比数据、合作方式，共八页。品牌要求在 README 里。下一步怎么做？先给建议，不用生成文件。
帮我做一张手机上能填写的设备报修表，姓名、设备编号、故障描述、紧急程度和提交按钮，工人戴手套也要容易点，先在本地用假数据演示。
我们咨询公司的页面方向就定为暖白底、深棕正文、大标题和细线分区，不用卡片。已有项目主要是服务介绍和预约咨询。先用文字整理这套方案如何应用到这些功能，不创建文件。这个方向我已经认可。
我想做一个给小店老板用的产品，可能管库存，也可能管客户回访，还没想清楚。现在只讨论最先解决哪个问题，不讨论界面或制作。
只把这句 PPT 文案改得简洁一点：“我们的解决方案能够全面赋能企业的全流程数字化转型升级。”不要讨论排版或配色。
api.py 的 stock_delta 算错了，出库数量应该从当前库存中扣除。只修计算，不要改页面。
app.js 的库存筛选有个 bug：关键词前后有空格就搜不到。只在过滤前去掉首尾空格，不改变页面结构和任何样式。
把 colors.csv 的十六进制颜色转成 R、G、B 三列，保留原来的名称列，输出 converted.csv。只做数据转换。
现在先确定设备报修登记需要哪些字段、哪些必填，以及设备编号怎么校验。只给字段清单和规则，不做表单页面或排版。
